notes.title: HellCome is Released!!
notes.content:
Hi fellas, we've started the development of HellCome a looong time ago! Finally, we released it. It was quite though and painful journey especially for me as the developer. We hope to harvest the fruits of our labor. You can play it now. Please leave a positive feedback to keep us going! 😂
Enjoy!

notes.title: Demo is better now
notes.content: We polished the game a little bit more. Have Fun!

notes.title: Dev Live Stream
notes.content: Hey everyone! We arranged a dev live stream. We'll be playing HellCome as the team, show you the gameplay, give you some info about the backstory of the development process and the future plans for the game. Join us!

notes.title: New Update! Our demo (0.1.04) now has Full Controller Support!
notes.content:
Now you can use your controllers in Menus as well. Have Fun & Don't forget to Wishlist HellCome! 

We rebalanced the hardness of enemies vs base stats of Characters,
We added some new skills and buffed some existing skills as well...

For the next update we are working on a New Game Mode! So Stay Tuned!!..

notes.title: New Update! Our demo (0.1.03) now has Controller Support!
notes.content:
Now you can use your controllers in game. Have Fun & Don't forget to Wishlist HellCome! 
We are working hard for fixing issues and adding new features for making the game better and better everyday.

notes.title: New Update! Our demo (0.1.02) is now better and stronger!
notes.content:
Hey, We heard your feedback and We are very GRATEFUL for it...
Thank you all who played our demo, who wishlisted our game and who took the time to gave us invaluable feedback.
We evaluated common gameplay feedbacks;
[list]
[*]Fixed Exp Points being unpickable.
[*]Fixed Meat Hook rope going crazy.
[*]Fixed Enemies being able to spawn very close.
[*]Changed Enemy Hardness scaling.
[/list]
Have Fun!!
